description: Your hand-off's own worktree: {path, branch, base, created, merged_from, conflict}. Work only there, never in the person's folder. A hand-off that points at the person's folder gets one now (from the environment's branch, the person's branch merged in) and works there from then on; the page's selection does not change. handoff_id defaults to the selected environment's open hand-off.

handoff_id.description: The hand-off (default: the selected environment's open one). `id` works too.

response_schema.description: The worktree a hand-off works in: never the person's checkout.

base.description: What the worktree started from: the person's commit it took, else the environment's head.

conflict.description: The person's commits conflict with the environment's branch: the worktree is at the base, and this says what to merge.

created.description: This call made the worktree; false: it was there.

merged_from.description: The person's branch (or the check's `source`) this call merged in on top of the environment's branch; null when nothing came in.

response_schema.title: HandoffWorktree
